_comment: JSS (makeStyles) and sx read numbers differently. Verified against @mui/system@7 (spacing.js, sizing.js, borders.js, cssGrid.js).
spacingShorthands: theme.spacing(n) with a single numeric literal -> sx shorthand with the bare number (sx multiplies by theme.spacing).
numericPx: properties where sx transforms a bare number (spacing multiplier, sizing 0<n<=1 -> %, borderRadius * shape.borderRadius,
border n -> 'npx solid'). JSS treats the same number as px, so numbers here are rewritten as explicit 'Npx' strings (0 stays 0).
jssOnly: key patterns that only JSS understands ($rule references, @global, plugins) – such styles are left for manual conversion.
